title: Run a step before a handler
summary: Fastify: Run a step before a handler. Change the school value.
introduction: A preHandler hook runs before the route handler. GET / uses the request field set by the hook.
learningObjectives: Run a step before a handler with Fastify

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.
Run a step before a handler

blocks.title: Run a step before a handler

blocks.text: decorateRequest declares the field. The hook fills it before the route reads it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use async hooks or callback hooks consistently; do not mix both styles.
